name: Wood
desc: Timber for houses, palisades and boats.

name: Clay
desc: Pots, and bricks once they learn to fire them.

name: Brick
desc: Fired clay. Strong houses and granaries.

name: Fibre
desc: Flax and kelp for rope, cloth and sails.

name: Salt
desc: Keeps food through winter and on long voyages.

name: Tin
desc: Mixed with copper it makes bronze.

name: Bronze
desc: Tools, blades and status. The mark of the Bronze Age.

name: Iron
desc: Ore smelted into iron: cheap, hard tools and weapons. The Classical age runs on it.

name: Spice
desc: Pepper, cloves and cinnamon from the Spice Isles. Worth a voyage across the world.

name: Coal
desc: Black rock that burns hot. Fuel for engines, furnaces and factories, and for the smoke.

name: Steel
desc: Iron refined with coal. Rails, ships, bridges and guns.

name: Oil
desc: Rock oil pumped from deep under the Great Land and the Spice Isles. Engines, planes and plastics.

name: Silicon
desc: Pure sand, melted into crystal. Kelp Isle's beaches become the chips inside every computer.
